title: DbContext in Entity Framework Core
description: Learn about the DbContext class, its tasks, and how to configure database connections.

data.text: The **DbContext** class is an integral part of Entity Framework. An instance of `DbContext` represents a session with the database which can be used to query and save instances of your entities.

data.title: Design Patterns
data.text: DbContext is a combination of the Unit of Work and Repository patterns.
